item.title: Overcoming the Spin Barrier of Oxygen Redox Chemistry in Lithium–Oxygen Batteries via Metal–Support Magnetic Interaction
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Metal–support magnetic interaction is used to overcome the spin barrier in Li–O₂ batteries. Interfacial magnetic coupling between Pd and ferrimagnetic CoFe₂O₄ restructures Pd spin states, promoting triplet O₂ conversion to peroxide while suppressing singlet O₂. This yields a 0.05 V charging overpotential and 91.2% energy efficiency, establishing a general design principle for spin-dependent oxygen electrocatalysis.

item.title: Interfacial Instability of Halide Solid Electrolytes and Oxide Cathodes Under Low‐Humidity Dry‐Room Conditions
item.description:
این مقاله نشان می‌دهد الکترولیت‌های جامد هالیدی و کاتدهای اکسیدی حتی در اتاق خشک با نقطه شبنم -40 درجه سانتی‌گراد دچار تخریب بین‌سطحی و افت عملکرد الکتروشیمیایی می‌شوند.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study reveals that halide solid electrolyte/oxide cathode composites degrade severely under low-humidity dry-room conditions (dew point −40°C), not just inert gloveboxes. Dry-room exposure forms a passivation layer hindering Li+ transport, worsening electrochemical performance across multiple halide/oxide pairs. This identifies a previously overlooked processing-induced interfacial challenge, highlighting the need to prioritize composite-cathode stability under realistic manufacturing conditions.
🏷 halide solid electrolyte · oxide cathode · interfacial instability · dry-room processing · all-solid-state battery

item.title: A Phosphazene‐Polyphenol Network Binder Enables Catalytic Polysulfide Conversion and Intrinsic Flame Retardancy for Practical Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
item.description:
بایندر شبکه‌ای فسفازن-پلی‌فنول با سایت‌های فعال ناهمگون، تبدیل پلی‌سولفید و بازدارندگی شعله ذاتی را برای باتری‌های Li-S عملی فراهم می‌کند.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a cross-linked phosphazene-polyphenol binder (HTP) integrating tannic acid, polyethyleneimine, and a phosphorus/nitrogen-rich framework. It simultaneously catalyzes polysulfide conversion, accommodates cathode swelling, and imparts intrinsic flame retardancy. Significance: exceptional cycling stability (0.025% fade/cycle over 2000 cycles), high areal capacity (7.5 mAh cm⁻²) under practical conditions, offering a multifunctional binder paradigm for safe, high-energy Li-S batteries.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · phosphazene binder · polysulfide conversion · flame retardancy · tannic acid
